text:
Marta: quick convo about fallback rules for speculative decoding. want something safe, low-change, easy to roll back.
Kevin: i like minimal heuristics first. dynamic patience + token-prob checks. keep it inexpensive.
Raj: ran a fast pass yesterday: randomized prefetch + tiny backoff. throughput +1.9x, ppl +0.9% (worse), some coherence drops on long-dialog prompts.
Sophie: noted. we should catch hallucination patterns early. maybe a tiny heuristic that forces full decode when coherence metric dips.
Marta: propose smoke plan: collect 5k chat prompts (prod routes), run baseline vs speculative+fallback, measure ppl, QA-F1, BLEU, fallback-rate, and manual spot-checks for weird hallucinations.
Kevin: proto heuristic idea: if moving avg top1 < 0.18 for window of 4 tokens -> rollback for that request. pseudo:
```
# pseudo
if moving_avg(top1_prob, window=4) < 0.18:
    mark_fallback(request_id)
    restart_with_full_sampler()
```
Raj: alternative: run a micro-reranker (single linear layer over logits) that outputs accept/reject probability. it's cheap on CPU if we quantize the weights. if reject -> full decode.
Sophie: we already have a compact safety classifier. risk is added tail latency if ran sync. consider async scoring for best-effort safety signals.
Marta: deploy plan: canary to us-west, small % of traffic, 95p latency, tokens/sec, fallback-rate, and QA-F1 on the eval set tracked. rollback if >1% absolute QA-F1 regression.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: spec-decoder-fallback-canary -> us-west at 2025-11-03T02:00:00Z
Kevin: i'll own the rollback PR and the canary flag. will run the 5k eval tonight and push results to the ticket.
Raj: i'll build reranker POC and export sampled tokens + logits for analysis. will tag the datasets.
Sophie: small manual checklist: 1) check long-dialog coherence, 2) diff examples where fallback triggered, 3) verify no spike in 99p latency, 4) QA-F1/BLEU on named-entity QA tasks.
Marta: agree. quality-first: if manual checks show hallucination uptick or QA-F1 regression >1% absolute, abort canary. tagging @Kevin @Raj @Sophie for followups. thanks :raised_hands:
